_meta.purpose: Per-person admin assignments for LIMEN domain access. Passcodes are NOT here — they live in Vercel env vars (one per person, named in envVar). This file only maps a person to their display name + the domains/properties they manage. Edit to add people or change assignments; set the matching env var in Vercel.
_meta.howToAddPasscode: In the Vercel project env, set the envVar below to that person's passcode. Master/operator passcode = env ADMIN_MASTER (grants all domains).
